job.job_description:
AI Engineer (Senior)
Location: PAN India
Experience-4+ Years
Role Description
Responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining AI/ML models and AI-powered applications. Build AI agents, optimize model performance, monitor production systems, troubleshoot technical issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI solutions. Contribute to continuous model improvement through data validation, fine-tuning, and performance monitoring.
Key Skills

Programming: Python, SQL
Machine Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn
Generative AI & NLP: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, RAG
Model Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Azure AI Services
Monitoring & MLOps: MLflow, Azure Monitor, Logging
DevOps: Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD
Methodologies: Agile, Problem Solving, Collaboration

Preferred Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, or other enterprise AI platforms.

Exposure to MLOps and AI governance
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
